Net Profit is the continuing operations subtotal so that profit before tax less income tax ties exactly; discontinued operations added a further 135809 and are excluded from this column. | CRON 20261113_0530: annual columns were exactly 1000x the same company's ISIN-keyed file and 1000x the issuer's own FY2025 earnings release (ir.te.eg, 26 February 2026: revenue EGP 106,673 million, FY2024 81,678 million, EBIT 42,884 and 26,036, NPAT 22,555 and 10,098, EPS 11.93 and 4.79). The four FY columns were divided by 1000 to EGP units, which reproduces the issuer revenue to the million; the interim column was already correct and is untouched. Profit basis: the Profit Before Tax less Income Tax rows tie to total profit including non-controlling interests (30,911 - 8,569 = 22,342 million for FY2025 against the issuer's printed NPAT of 22,555 million), while the Net Profit row carries the amount attributable to owners of the parent (20,371 million). The two are different bases, not a scale error.
